policy: All 16 native off anchors and 16 on anchors byte-close before any remaining question, then one model and two separately selected native calls per remaining question. Responses are preserved before inspection. No retry or automatic GPU queue.
limits: Same legacy-position paired implementation diagnosis, not the paper score or a new pruning method.
Old full K256 internal states were not saved; 16 previous exact paired arrays are the historical internal anchor.
For other 5333 pairs, actual high-dimensional arrays are hashed but not saved; independent verification cannot reconstruct those tensor values.
The old input preparation had previously read canonical data to construct the answer-free manifest; this task does not read GT or score files.
Changing DS can naturally change KV and generated suffix; compare continuation only for common generated prefixes.
Runtime and disk cost are instrumentation-dependent and not a model performance benchmark.
